name: Update Adherence (UA)
description: Benchmark scenarios, event records, frozen memory engine, and scoring scripts for the paper "Two-Stage Measurement of Update Adherence in Language Model Memory Agents". Update Adherence (UA) measures whether a revised requirement, and not the statement it replaced, governs the answer of a language model agent with external memory. It is scored at two stages with deterministic rules and no language-model judge, in the assembled context that the memory system hands to the answering model and in the generated answer. Every number in the paper can be recomputed from the files in this archive with python analysis/make_tables.py. Code is under the MIT License. Scenario data, result data, and figure data are under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
